subject: Compliance packaging options + concession ask for TallTree Health
messages:
From: Alexa Murray <alexa.murray@talltreehealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Compliance packaging — audit logs / HSM / residency questions

Hi Elliot,

Thanks again for the demo yesterday. Procurement asked I follow up with a few specific pricing and packaging questions so we can decide which path to include in our RFP response:

- Can you outline the economics between a) recurring audit-log retention tiers (90/365/7 yrs) billed per GB vs b) a flat evidence-seat / observability-seat model? Which is more common for customers at our scale (~15M tokens/month)?
- For KMS/HSM: is there a per-key seat, a per-HSM slab, or is that amortized into an "implementation" line item? If there’s an implementation fee, is it tradable for credits against monthly usage?
- Residency: we’ll likely need a US-only data residency with an option to expand to EU. Do you offer a hybrid residency-lite bundle (audit logs + geo-routing) that’s cheaper than full sovereign deployment?
- What discount should we expect for a 12-month committed seat + 50% volume growth commitment?

Can you send a short one-pager with 2–3 packaging options and a sample quote (line items only) we can attach to our procurement packet? Procurement is on copy: procurement@talltreehealth.com.

Thanks — if it helps we can take a 30-min call later this week.

Best,
Alexa Murray
Head of Platform Partnerships
TallTree Health

Attachment: none

From: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Murray <alexa.murray@talltreehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-20T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — audit logs / HSM / residency questions

Alexa — thanks for the clear list. I put together a short options doc and included a sample line-item quote (attached). High-level summary below.

Attachment: Compliance_Pricing_Options_Q2.pdf (4 pages)

Snapshot (ballpark; all USD/month unless noted):

Option A — Compliance Starter (lowest friction)
- Audit logs: 90d retention, billed $0.08/GB-month
- KMS: managed keys included (software KMS), HSM available as add-on $1,200/month per HSM slab
- Residency: US routing only, no dedicated infrastructure
- Implementation fee: $8,000 one-time (can be converted to credits with 12m commit)

Option B — HIPAA+Evidence (recommended for production PHI)
- Audit logs: 365d retention, billed $0.14/GB-month OR audit-seat model $1,500/month (up to 10k events/day)
- HSM: $2,500/month per physical HSM slab or $18k upfront amortized over 12 months
- Residency: US-dedicated (shared host) — additional $6,000/month
- Implementation fee: $22,000 one-time (recommended amortize as credits for committed deals)

Option C — Sovereign-ready (full on-prem/VPC style)
- Audit logs: 7yr retention, custom pricing (large fixed and egress components)
- HSM: dedicated appliances + ops — custom
- Residency: full dedicated stack (EU/US) — custom
- Implementation and evidence delivery fees apply — we lay these out in the attached workbook.

Discount guidance: for a 12-month commit with 50% growth guarantee we typically offer 10–20% off recurring add-ons and convert up to 50% of the implementation fee into monthly credits (amount depends on ARR). I called out a recommended concession path in the spreadsheet.

Next steps: if you can share an expected monthly token/GB profile (or a target spend), we’ll firm numbers and propose a concession matrix. Happy to book a 30-min call — I’m available Thu/Fri afternoon PT.

—Elliot
Elliot Price
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
Phone: (415) 555-0194

From: Alexa Murray <alexa.murray@talltreehealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, procurement@talltreehealth.com
Date: 2027-06-21T08:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — audit logs / HSM / residency questions

Thanks Elliot — this helps. Quick clarifications before procurement drafts an SOW:

- TallTree estimate today: ~15M tokens/month (~1.2TB audit-log ingest/month); pilot months may be lower.
- Procurement request: can you show a worked example that converts the implementation fee into monthly credits for Option B? Procurement prefers credits over upfront payments.
- KMS behavior: we need customer-managed keys (BYOK) — can this be done with your managed HSM slab or only with dedicated HSM?
- Residency: for now we only need US-dedicated (no EU yet) but want an inexpensive upgrade path to EU in 6–9 months.

Procurement put a placeholder that they may push for a 15% implementation-fee waiver in exchange for a 12-month commit. Is that a concession you can support?

Procurement will also need a redlineable quote and a DocuSign-ready cover.

Alexa

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alexa Murray <alexa.murray@redwoodhealth.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-22T09:01:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Compliance packaging — audit logs / HSM / residency questions

Alexa — looped in Ben to validate economics and concession mechanics. A couple internal notes for transparency (quoted below).

Quoted: On Mon, Jun 21, 2027 at 08:22 AM Alexa Murray wrote:
> Thanks Elliot — this helps. Quick clarifications before procurement drafts an SOW:
> - TallTree estimate today: ~15M tokens/month (~1.2TB audit-log ingest/month); pilot months may be lower.

What I recommend:
1) Offer Option B as the commercial baseline for procurement (HIPAA+Evidence).
2) Move 60% of the implementation fee into a 12-month monthly credit schedule so TallTree has near-zero upfront cash. We keep a smaller up-front intake to cover delivery risk.
3) Provide an "upgrade voucher": if they expand to EU dedicated within 9 months we apply a one-time credit equal to 25% of the initial implementation fee toward the EU onboarding.
4) For BYOK: confirm with engineering but we can support BYOK with our managed HSM offering (requires additional attestation + 2-week lead time).

Ben — any redlines on the concession numbers above?

—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Director, Enterprise Sales Operations
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-06-23T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: RE: Compliance packaging — audit logs / HSM / residency questions

Short answer: yes to Marissa’s plan with small tweaks.

- Implementation fee: we can convert up to 60% into monthly credits for a 12m commit. If procurement pushes for a waiver, we can offer a 15% reduction on the remaining upfront portion (i.e., effectively 15% off the small cash portion).
- Recurring discount: 12m commit + growth guard => 12% off recurring add-ons (audit logs + residency). If they pre-pay annually we can push to 18%.
- HSM/BYOK: managed HSM + BYOK requires a one-time attestation fee ($3,500) and a 2-3 week lead time to provision.

I’ll draft the concession matrix and send the workbook.

—Ben
Ben Carter
Head of Pricing & Packaging, Redwood Inference

From: Alexa Murray <alexa.murray@talltreehealth.com>
To: Elliot Price <elliot.price@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@talltreehealth.com
Date: 2027-06-25T16:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Compliance packaging — audit logs / HSM / residency questions

Elliot / Marissa — thanks, this looks workable. Procurement confirmed they will accept the 60% credit conversion and request the 15% reduction on the residual upfront as a final ask. They attached a placeholder PO (attached) and asked us to return a DocuSign link for the final quote & SOW.

Can you please:
1) Send a revised quote that shows the implementation fee broken into: upfront cash, monthly credits (12 months), and the 15% residual reduction.
2) Include the BYOK attestation fee line and the 2–3 week provisioning note.
3) Provide the DocuSign envelope link for procurement to sign.

Procurement is ready to fast-track if we can turn the quote quickly.

Alexa Murray
Head of Platform Partnerships
TallTree Health

Attachment: TallTree_PO_48721.pdf (placeholder)
